title: Addictive Taste
paragraphs: “I understand. So, what I need to do is storm the castle again and take down the leader once more, correct?”
“Well, yeah, that’s how it is. But this is about bringing the Queen back, not just killing them.”
“Not sure if they’ll back down, though.”
“The Queen is still the rightful ruler. She’s already in secret contact with the pro-Queen faction in Melromarc. We’ll handle things so she can return to Melromarc soon.”
“We are grateful for the benevolence of the heroes.”
The Queen is bowing her head to us. For now, our course of action is decided.
“This was originally a problem we caused, in a way, so don’t worry about it. Please think of it as atonement, at the very least.”
Father said this while shifting his gaze toward me, Ren, and Itsuki, then muttered softly.
“That power is the only way to solve this… If only there were a better way… right?”

His words carried a tone of self-mockery. This is quite a complicated issue, isn’t it? Even Father seems to be struggling with this one. If it were up to me, I’d just erase Melromarc from existence and be done with it. That would be far easier.
“Don’t say that, Naofumi-san. Sometimes, wielding power is necessary when upholding justice.”

“It’s idealistic to think you can silence those who act selfishly and increase the number of victims without using force. Some problems can’t be solved with money or authority alone. I’ve heard war is the same.”
Itsuki and Ren tried to console Father’s lament.
“I can never fully express my gratitude for the heroes’ cooperation. Iwatani-dono’s fundamental desire to resolve matters peacefully has reached us. But for now, I believe we must do what we can.”
“…Yeah, thank you, everyone. Alright, starting tomorrow, let’s go deal with Melromarc’s mess.”
After finalizing things with the Queen, we returned to our rooms to rest. Before noon the next day…

It seems the Pig King is still asleep. From what I hear, he spent the entire night mingling with pigs in front of Takt. Father was playing around with Mole, who was sitting on his lap. Mole remained quiet, looking slightly embarrassed. Sakura-chan had gone to visit Fiancé. I suppose that means they’re good friends. It frustrates me, but while I can be the parent of the Filolials, I can never be their friend.
“I’m jealous… Gaelion wants to sit on Naofumi’s lap too.”
Rival narrowed her eyes as he watched Father and Assistant. I should probably keep an eye on her and see what she’s planning.
“You were just sitting on his lap a moment ago.”
Now that I think about it, that was true. Taking advantage of Sakura-chan’s absence to do as he pleases—how selfish!
“By the way, Naofumi, is lunch ready yet?”
“Oh, come on…” Father responded to Ren, sounding exasperated.
Come to think of it, Itsuki said something similar this morning.
Do they love eating that much?
At this rate, they’ll end up getting as fat as the Pig King!
“Now that we’ve arrived in Faubrey, you should eat the lavish meals prepared by the country instead of my cooking.”
“That’s easy to say, but the food is way too greasy and heavy. That mountain of dishes is just…” Itsuki joined the conversation.
Even though he was focused on something else just moments ago—what’s going on?
Is food really that important to them?
“The taste… I don’t want to admit it, but for some reason, it’s actually good. It’s strange. It should rank among the best meals I’ve ever had, yet…”
“Exactly. It makes you want to eat more just to satisfy your appetite. In contrast, Naofumi-san’s cooking feels satisfying even with a small portion.”
Ren nodded repeatedly at Itsuki’s words. Indeed, Father’s cooking is delicious. As for the portion sizes, I wouldn’t know.
“You’re talking as if you’re addicted…”
“In a way, it might be. The flavor is just that habit-forming.”
“It just means it’s that good.”
“…Aren’t you two just trying to make me cook?”
“Guess we got caught.”
“Busted, huh?”
“If you’re already saying this on just the second day in Faubrey, I don’t want to imagine what’s coming next,” Father sighed as he stroked the mole sitting on his lap.

Perhaps he was combing its fur? Now that I look closely, Mole’s coat does seem shinier than before. As expected of Father. Come to think of it, he did the same for Yuki and the others. Well, Yuki and the rest are naturally clean creatures. I do it too, but Father even takes care of Mole and Rival. I hadn’t been paying much attention to Rival since she was outside my field of vision, but her scales are looking glossier.
Is Assistant grooming her too?
“Well, I wouldn’t mind making some snacks for a change of pace, but… Motoyasu-kun? You’re staring at Imiya-chan and Gaelion-chan—something wrong?”
“Are you grooming their fur?”
“Hmm? Well, yeah. They’ll be appearing in public, after all. I did it yesterday too, you know?”
“Naofumi-san, you’re surprisingly meticulous about these things. Since we’re at the castle, wouldn’t it be fine to let the castle staff handle it?”
“Exactly. You can freely arrange clothing too, right? Why not make use of that?”
“And yet, you were both trying to make me cook… what are you even saying?” Father spoke to Ren and Itsuki, sounding exasperated.
They’re oddly quick-witted when it comes to things like this.
“Takt called Imiya-chan bad taste, but we have to prove that she’s nothing like that.”
“I-It’s fine… really. I don’t mind,” Mole answered in a voice so embarrassed it sounded like it might die from shame.

She must be feeling Father’s kindness firsthand. This mole is quite the reserved creature. She’s skilled enough with her hands to have made clothes for the villagers, yet she rarely stands out. If I recall correctly… I once heard that the gloves Father uses for his work were made by Mole.

Would the loops cause any differences? Honestly, I don’t really care, but I do acknowledge that Mole’s sewing skills are quite impressive. I heard she even made the clothes for Keel’s peddling business, and the Filolials seemed to take an interest too. But when it comes to sewing, I refuse to lose.
“Yes… Not just raising my level, but… I want to be more useful…”
“Oh? So not sewing?”
“Now that you mention it, Imiya-chan said she used to sew in her original world.”
Father had been informed of the kind of work Mole used to do. He also knows how skilled she is.
“The Naofumi from the original world apparently didn’t have many resources or much support. He probably had Imiya learn sewing as a cost-saving measure.”
“On the other hand, we’re currently well-supported.”
“I see… Well, if that’s what Imiya-chan chose, we’ll support her. But Imiya-chan, you should find your relatives and be happy with them. Don’t forget that.”
At that, Mole nodded, but she seemed slightly downcast. As if she wanted to say that once she reunites with her relatives, they’d have to part ways.
“Naofumi-san, you’re pretty dense, aren’t you?”
“I understand that she relies on me, but I don’t want to be the kind of person who happily sends Imiya-chan off to battle. I won’t take advantage of kindness like that.”
Mole, perhaps understanding that sentiment, looked embarrassed.
